name: compression-search-v1
strict_success: Mean fresh-audit loss no greater than the full-pool control at the same 400 updates; artifact smaller than the full training token array.
selection: Choose candidates by development loss and artifact bytes only; freeze finalists before audit evaluation.
gradient_track: Replay compressed gradients through the unchanged Muon/AdamW optimizers. Report known-initialization and unseen-initialization results separately.
tweet_policy: Draft only. Claim compression or acceleration only when supported by the corresponding measured comparison.
